subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should maintainers replace the open conflicting fork PR with a fresh target-repo fix, adopt and rebase that branch, or wait for the fork author to refresh it?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but an open fork PR still claims the closing fix and is conflicting, so automation should not create a duplicate fix lane until branch ownership is decided.

options.title: Replace With Fresh Fix
options.body: Retire or close the conflicting fork PR and allow a new narrow OpenClaw PR against current main, preserving contributor context in the replacement body if reused.

options.title: Adopt And Rebase Fork
options.body: A maintainer can manually port the useful fork changes onto current main, fix the owner-status concerns, and close the fork after replacement exists.

options.title: Wait For Contributor
options.body: Leave this issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase and provide current proof before any new fix lane starts.

recommendation.title: Replace With Fresh Fix
recommendation.body: Retire or close the conflicting fork PR and allow a new narrow OpenClaw PR against current main, preserving contributor context in the replacement body if reused.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest recent history on the doctor health-check contract and session-lock diagnostic surface where this work should be wired.
